title: Rakuten Mobile – CITIUSCOMM
p: Rakuten, Inc. is a Japanese electronic commerce and online retailing company based in Tokyo and was founded in 1997 by Japanese businessman Hiroshi Mikitani, Now Rakuten has planned to launch fully virtualized telecom network across Japan. This will be first kind of network launched across global by any telecom provider.
Planned to have target to get app 10 -15 Mn subscriber within time span of 3 years.

Citius is successful in providing various solutions to Rakuten i.e RAN site solution(4G/5G Antenna and its accesories, DAS solutions , Security core solutions (DDOS, Network Analytics, DPI etc.) and working continuously to get many more.
